purpose: Seed-robustness replication of the v8 combined fix: identical recipe and 100k budget with training seed 1 (the original used seed 0). Directly addresses the paper's declared single-seed claim limit for the Pareto-escape result (seed-0 run: TVR .122, centroid speed .286 at 100k). Predeclared n=64 milestone evaluations at 10k/40k/100k. Prediction (written before results): metrics land within ~0.03-0.05 of the seed-0 curve at matched steps.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Single-seed combined-treatment run; attribution of any gain to individual components rests on the matched 2k pilots, not on this run.
